env.name: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN
env.description: A Telegram bot token from @BotFather (looks like "123456789:ABCdefGhIJKlmNoPQRsTUVwxyZ") — message @BotFather on Telegram and run /newbot to create one. Set per agent: each agent that installs this ability needs its own bot, so two agents never post as the same bot or compete for its updates.

env.name: TELEGRAM_DEFAULT_CHAT_ID
env.description: A numeric chat/group/channel id (e.g. "-1001234567890" for a group/channel, a positive number for a private chat) or a public channel username (e.g. "@mychannel") to send to when a call doesn't specify one explicitly. For a private chat, the target user must have already started a conversation with the bot (sent /start) — a bot cannot message a user cold. For a group or channel, the bot must already be a member (and, for a channel, usually an admin able to post). An agent can set its own value in its Environment tab; an agent that doesn't uses the shared one.
